headings.rules: Must use tight tracking for headlines, uppercase overlines with high letter-spacing

katana_slash_arc.trigger: Click on About Katana in WeaponRain R3F canvas or 'S' key press / slash button interaction

arc_motion.rotation: Swift 140-degree diagonal sweep across portrait focal plane
arc_motion.trail_particle_burst: Bright cyan/magenta blade arc ribbon mesh with additive opacity fading over 180ms
arc_motion.audio_tactile: Synergized slash sfx call via useSound with mild 15-20px screen shake

screen_shake.intensity: Translation offset [-6px to +6px, -4px to +4px] with high-frequency spring decay
screen_shake.target: About section container or global screen wrapper

orbital_star_comet_trail.target: Skills section R3F OrbitStar in WeaponRain.tsx

comet_tail.trail_length: 8 to 12 trailing ghost sprites / instance points following the orbital trajectory
comet_tail.decay_opacity: Linear decay from 0.85 opacity at head to 0 opacity at tail tip
comet_tail.scale_taper: 1.0 scale at star head tapering down to 0.15 at tail end
comet_tail.update_rate: Updated per frame inside R3F useFrame using queue of last N positions

motion_timing.katana_slash: 350ms total execution (50ms windup, 100ms main sweep, 200ms recovery glow fade)
motion_timing.star_orbit: 3.0s cycle time for 360-degree orbit loop with smooth continuous trail interpolation

reduced_motion_behavior.prefers_reduced_motion: When active, disable screen shake vibration and replace intense camera motion with a gentle 200ms soft pulse emission opacity flare on the katana blade and static glow trail on the star.

3d_libraries.canvas_layering: About canvas is pointer-events-none absolute overlay over portrait; Skills canvas floats above skill cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve current layout in About and Skills sections.

Enhance /app/frontend/src/components/three/WeaponRain.tsx to support Katana click detection (via raycasting or pointer-events handling on Katana object) and trigger the full slash arc animation + screen shake.
Add fading comet trail instance array / ribbon trail to OrbitStar inside WeaponRain.tsx using ring/sprite positions queue or line geometry with opacity decay.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Implement prefers-reduced-motion checks for slash shake and trail density.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
